title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on John 4: the woman at Jacob's well, living water, worship in spirit and truth, and the nobleman's son.

questions.text: By which well did Jesus sit down, tired from his journey?
questions.explanation: Jacob's well was there, near the city of Samaria called Sychar, and Jesus, being tired from his journey, sat down by it about the sixth hour.

answers.text: Jacob's well
The pool called Bethesda
A well at Cana of Galilee
The spring at Enon near Salim

questions.text: What did Jesus ask the woman of Samaria for?
questions.explanation: A woman of Samaria came to draw water, and Jesus said to her, "Give me a drink."

answers.text: Her water pot
Bread from the city
A drink
A place to rest

questions.explanation: His disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

answers.text: Back to Judea
Into the city to buy food
To the mountain to pray
Across the sea by boat

questions.text: What did Jesus say he would have given her if she had asked?
questions.explanation: He said that if she knew the gift of God and who was asking her for a drink, she would have asked him, and he would have given her living water.

answers.text: A prophet's blessing
Bread out of heaven
A place among the true worshipers
Living water

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the water he gives?
questions.explanation: He said whoever drinks of the water he gives will never thirst again, and that water will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.

answers.text: Whoever drinks it will never thirst again
It must be drawn again each morning
It can only be drawn from Jacob's well
It is for the Jews and not the Samaritans

questions.text: What did Jesus tell the woman about her husbands?
questions.explanation: He told her she had had five husbands, and the one she now had was not her husband, and that she had spoken truly in saying she had no husband.

answers.text: Her husband had died in the city of Sychar long ago
She had never been married to any man in Samaria
Her husband was waiting for her back in the city
She had had five husbands, and the one she now had was not her husband

questions.text: What did Jesus say about God and the way he must be worshiped?
questions.explanation: He said, "God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth."

answers.text: God must be worshiped on this mountain
God must be worshiped only in Jerusalem
God is spirit, and worshipers must worship in spirit and truth
God must be worshiped with water and fire

questions.text: What did the woman say to the people in the city?
questions.explanation: She left her water pot, went into the city and said, "Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?"

answers.text: "A prophet is sitting at Jacob's well outside the city"
"Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?"
"The Messiah has gone up to Jerusalem to the feast"
"A Jew at the well has asked me for a drink of water"

questions.text: What did Jesus say his food was?
questions.explanation: He said, "My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work."

answers.text: The bread his disciples had bought in the city
The fruit of the fields white for harvest
The wages that the one who reaps receives
To do the will of him who sent him and to accomplish his work

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the nobleman who begged him to come and heal his son?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to him, "Go your way. Your son lives," and the man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went his way.

answers.text: "Go your way. Your son lives"
"Bring the boy here to me"
"Your faith has made him well"
"I will come down with you to Capernaum"
